messages:
marta: FYI I spotted a few console observability examples failing in the docs preview. looks like three categories: palette rename for heatmaps, latency bucketing param renamed, and an old CDN path used for static icons. starting a focused cleanup thread.

kevin: can you paste the failing log output? might be quick to fix.

marta: renderer error: `UnknownPaletteError: 'coolwarm' not recognized` from examples/console/dashboards/heatmap-examples/*.md. also some latency quickstarts still use `latency_buckets`.

ash: quick repro for latency issue: current snippet:```json
{"route":"/v1/gen","latency_buckets":[0,50,150,400]}
```should be `latency_ranges`.

kevin: plan: I can take the palette + CDN link PR (low risk). ash you take latency rename + a tiny compat shim and a short migration note. marta will coordinate preview checks. agree? :+1: 

marta: yep. small compatibility shim example for snippets is helpful. propose adding one-line shim in examples:```js
const ranges = cfg.latency_ranges || cfg.latency_buckets;
```

review-bot: automated scan: 19 files reference `latency_buckets`; 10 files mention `coolwarm`; 6 links to legacy-cdn.redwood.ai. No secrets detected.

kevin: opening PR for palette + link fixes now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9001. tagged @ux for a quick look since palette names change wording in the table.

ash: drafting PR for latency rename and compat shim: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9002. added a CI lint command to fail if `latency_buckets` remains in examples/: `rg -n \"latency_buckets\" examples/ || true` and the PR description includes the replacement script.

pm-ela: please add a one-line note to the release-notes draft so PMs can mention it: "Observability docs: heatmap palette names and latency param renamed; examples include compatibility shims."

kevin: added small screenshots for `viridis` vs `plasma` in PR 9001 per UX request. kept images tiny.

marta: merging plan: merge 9001 first, rebase 9002, run docs-preview pipeline, then validate screenshots and logs. will monitor the preview job and post results here.

ash: created follow-up issue for headless rendering tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4521 - "Render all console dashboard examples headlessly in CI". tagging `docs` `observability` `tests`.

marta: thanks team. target: link/palette fixes in next 6 hours, latency rename by EOD. I'll post preview logs once jobs complete. :rocket:
